description: Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh – In a landmark initiative to bridge the digital divide and boost youth employability, the Government of Uttar Pradesh has launched ‘AI-PRAGYA’ (Artificial Intelligence Programme for Resourcefulness, Awareness, Growth, and Youth Advancement).
body_lead: Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh – In a landmark initiative to bridge the digital divide and boost youth employability, the Government of Uttar Pradesh has launched ‘AI-PRAGYA’ (Artificial Intelligence Programme for Resourcefulness, Awareness, Growth, and Youth Advancement). The visionary programme was inaugurated in the presence of Hon’ble Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath and World Bank President Ajay Banga.
